annotations.text:
What this page is for

The newsletter is the product. The signup sits in the hero, above the fold, and again in the band lower down. Paid reports are the second ask, and the live data app is third.

Until newsletter.formAction is set in app.config.json, both forms render inert and say so, rather than collecting an address and dropping it.

Media slots

Four placeholders: finland-photo, lithuania-chart, and the two data panels (prices-chart, flows-map) which ship with a drawn sample.

On the canvas, seed an image with --image and reference it by bare filename. In the repo, add it to assets/manifest.json instead.

Pricing

The three tiers come from reports.tiers in app.config.json. A tier with no price shows "Price on request"; a tier with no checkoutUrl falls back to the newsletter as a waitlist and says so on the card.

Nothing here quotes a price you have not set.

Market data

The rail and the price chart are illustrative of the Nordic-Baltic spread, not quotations. They are labelled SAMPLE FEED until liveDataApp.url is set.

Article copy is sourced and linked; figures that are not yet confirmed stay bracketed — [PHOTO CREDIT], [CONTACT EMAIL].
